statement: The HHS Office for Civil Rights breach portal posts a hacking or IT incident breach filed by an entity whose name contains Nutex, with a submission date between 2026-08-25 and 2026-12-15.
resolution: TRUE if the OCR breach portal lists an entity containing Nutex, breach type hacking or IT incident, submission date between 2026-08-25 and 2026-12-15 inclusive.
failure_condition: The OCR portal carries no Nutex-named entity with a submission date inside that window.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: The LBMA Gold Price PM auction fixes at or above 5000.00 dollars per troy ounce on at least one business day between 2026-09-01 and 2026-11-30.
resolution: TRUE if any LBMA Gold Price PM fix dated between 2026-09-01 and 2026-11-30 is 5000.00 dollars or higher in the published LBMA price record.
failure_condition: Every LBMA PM gold fix inside that window settles below 5000.00 dollars.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

failure_condition: No presidential document published inside that window imposes or raises duties on Canadian goods.
